title: Complete Guide to Java Concurrency
title_es: Guía Completa de Concurrencia en Java
description: Runnable Java examples: bounded ThreadPoolExecutor with backpressure, graceful shutdown, virtual-thread executor, circuit breaker, and contention tests.
